Dynamic length signals Description: The System Template shall support a definition of dynamic length signals. A Signal shall have either a static length or its length should vary up to some statically defined maximum. Signals with a maximum length are called dynamic length signals. Rationale: Dynamic length signals can change size during run time. Dependencies: None identified. Use Case:  Supporting Material: OSEK COM
